## Completion gates

- [ ] Issue acceptance criteria are met.
- [ ] A separate reviewer inspected actual changes and relevant test evidence.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshot inspection and design critique on desktop/mobile.
- [ ] Final visual acceptance uses a user-selected baseline under the [design-direction policy](https://github.com/lucasaerb/headstart/blob/main/docs/design-direction.md), or is explicitly pending (or N/A with reason); provisional mockups do not establish final design and pending acceptance prevents issue closure.
- [ ] Blocking findings were fixed by the coder and re-reviewed to PASS.
- [ ] Documentation and contracts reflect the final implementation.
